name: @starci/ai-router
description: A zero-dependency pool router for OpenAI-compatible APIs: many keys, many models and many providers behind one chat, stream and embeddings call, with health-aware selection, circuit breakers, rate-limit awareness, retries onto another key, model fallback and redacted telemetry.
author: starci183

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const f of fs.readdirSync('dist').filter((n) => n.endsWith('.d.ts'))) fs.writeFileSync('dist/' + f, fs.readFileSync('dist/' + f, 'utf8').replace(/(from \"\.\/[\w-]+)\.ts\"/g, '$1.js\"'))"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="src/**/*.ts" --test-coverage-lines=90 "test/**/*.test.ts"
